command:
mkdir -p /var/backups/inventory
cat > /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

SRC_HOST="node2"
SRC_PATH="/srv/inventory/data"
DEST_DIR="/var/backups/inventory"
RETAIN_DAYS=7
DATE="$(date +%Y-%m-%d)"
WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)"
ARCHIVE="$DEST_DIR/inventory-$DATE.tar.gz"

trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR"' EXIT

mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"

rsync -a -e "ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new" \
  "root@${SRC_HOST}:${SRC_PATH}/" "$WORKDIR/data/"

tar -C "$WORKDIR" -czf "$ARCHIVE" data

find "$DEST_DIR" -maxdepth 1 -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -mtime "+$((RETAIN_DAYS - 1))" -delete

echo "backup complete: $ARCHIVE"
EOF
chmod 750 /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup.sh
